raw_segments.text: When the dole was ended, laughingly she said, Master of a million mouths is not one unfed.
Laughing, Shiv made answer, All have had their part, even he the little one hidden neath thy
From her breast she plucked it, Parvati the thief, saw the least of little things not
a new grown leaf, saw and feared and wondered, making prayer to Shiv, who hath surely given
meat to all that live, all things made he Shiva the preserver, Mahadeo, Mahadeo.
He made all thorn for the camel, fodder for the kind, and mother's heart for sleepy head,
